purpose: Loads, validates, translates, replicates, and exposes game configuration across server and client realms.
description: Loads, validates, translates, replicates, and exposes game configuration across server and client realms.

Client/Cmdr/GameConfigCommandServiceClie.description: Registers client Cmdr game-config argument types and displays the active config name in Cmdr. Public entry points include `GameConfigCommandServiceClient.Init`, `GameConfigCommandServiceClient.Start`, `GameConfigCommandServiceClient.Destroy`.

Client/Config/Asset/GameConfigAssetClien.description: Client model for a replicated configured asset. Public entry points include `GameConfigAssetClient.new`, `GameConfigAssetClient.ObserveTranslatedName`, `GameConfigAssetClient.ObserveTranslatedDescription`.

Client/Config/Config/GameConfigClient.lu.description: Client model for a replicated game configuration. Public entry points include `GameConfigClient.new`, `GameConfigClient.GetGameConfigAssetBinder`.

Client/GameConfigBindersClient.luau.description: Provides the client GameConfig and GameConfigAsset binders.

Client/GameConfigServiceClient.luau.description: Provides client-side reactive access to replicated game configurations. Public entry points include `GameConfigServiceClient.Init`, `GameConfigServiceClient.Start`, `GameConfigServiceClient.GetConfigPicker`, `GameConfigServiceClient.Destroy`.

Shared/Cmdr/GameConfigCmdrUtils.luau.description: Registers Cmdr argument types backed by the active GameConfigPicker. Public entry points include `GameConfigCmdrUtils.registerAssetTypes`, `GameConfigCmdrUtils.registerGiftAssetKeyType`, `GameConfigCmdrUtils.registerAssetType`.

Shared/Config/Asset/GameConfigAssetBase..description: Shared reactive model for a configured Roblox asset. Instances of this class are constructed by the server and client binders. Public entry points include `GameConfigAssetBase.new`, `GameConfigAssetBase.GetFolder`, `GameConfigAssetBase.GetAssetId`, `GameConfigAssetBase.ObserveAssetId`, `GameConfigAssetBase.GetAssetType`, `GameConfigAssetBase.ObserveAssetType`, `GameConfigAssetBase.GetAssetKey`,…

Shared/Config/Asset/GameConfigAssetConst.description: Attribute names used by game-config assets.

Shared/Config/Asset/GameConfigAssetUtils.description: Creates game-config assets and resolves their Roblox cloud metadata. Public entry points include `GameConfigAssetUtils.isValidAssetId`, `GameConfigAssetUtils.create`, `GameConfigAssetUtils.promiseCloudDataForAssetType`.

Shared/Config/AssetTypes/GameConfigAsset.description: Utilities for validating and naming game-config asset types. Public entry points include `GameConfigAssetTypeUtils.isAssetType`, `GameConfigAssetTypeUtils.getPlural`.
Enumerates every asset category understood by GameConfigService.

Shared/Config/Config/GameConfigBase.luau.description: Shared reactive model for one replicated game configuration. Public entry points include `GameConfigBase.new`, `GameConfigBase.GetFolder`, `GameConfigBase.GetGameId`, `GameConfigBase.ObserveGameId`, `GameConfigBase.GetConfigName`, `GameConfigBase.ObserveConfigName`, `GameConfigBase.GetAssetsOfType`, `GameConfigBase.GetAssetsOfTypeAndKey`.

Shared/Config/Config/GameConfigConstants.description: Attribute names used by game configurations.

Shared/Config/Config/GameConfigUtils.lua.description: Creates and observes the replicated Folder layout used by GameConfigService. Public entry points include `GameConfigUtils.create`, `GameConfigUtils.getOrCreateAssetFolder`, `GameConfigUtils.observeAssetFolderBrio`.

Shared/Config/Picker/GameConfigPicker.lu.description: Provides synchronous, promise-based, and reactive queries over all replicated game configurations that target the current universe. Public entry points include `GameConfigPicker.new`, `GameConfigPicker.GetActiveConfigs`, `GameConfigPicker.GetConfigsForGameId`, `GameConfigPicker.ObserveActiveConfigsBrio`, `GameConfigPicker.ObserveConfigsForGameIdBrio`, `GameConfigPicker.GetAllActiveAssetsOfType`,…

Shared/GameConfigDataService.luau.description: Small shared dependency that exposes the realm's active GameConfigPicker to packages which should not depend directly on the server or client service. Public entry points include `GameConfigDataService.Init`, `GameConfigDataService.SetConfigPicker`, `GameConfigDataService.GetConfigPicker`.

Shared/GameConfigTranslator.luau.description: Provides localized strings for game configurations.
